name: Orey-eyed Oghamist

facts.text: Level 73, 30,000 health, in the Cursed Forest. He casts Energy Blast (800 energy over 1,000), Greater Infirmity (strength and constitution debuff over 400) and a ranged swing for 500.
Ogham is the old Irish alphabet of strokes cut on stone and wood. 'Orey-eyed' is unglossed (to verify).

story:
Before the realm wrote in ink it wrote in ogham, strokes cut into the edges of standing stones, and the Oghamist was a cutter of them. He went into the court wood to read the stones the courts had left there, and read something he should not have, and his eyes have been strange ever since. He still carries his tools and still cuts. Every mark he makes in the air is a word of power, and the words he learned in the Cursed Forest are unkind ones: a word that bursts, a word that withers, a word that reaches out and cuts from far away.

Before Hibernia wrote in ink it wrote in ogham, strokes cut along the edge of a standing stone, and the cutters were respected people who travelled from chieftain to chieftain with their tools. The Oghamist was one of the best. He went into the court wood to read the stones the courts had set up there to record their bargains, and he read the one that recorded the bargain that broke. His eyes have been strange ever since: the Ardee folk call them orey, a word nobody can now explain, and nobody looks into them twice.

He still carries his tools and still cuts, but in the air now, and every stroke is a word of power. One word bursts in a blast of raw energy over a wide ring. One withers the strength and constitution of those near him. One reaches out and cuts from far away like a blade. The druids would very much like to know what the stone said. They would not like to read it.
legend: A caster, and a nasty one: his energy blast hits everyone over a wide area, so spread far. He weakens strength and constitution around him, so rebuff, and his ranged cut hits hard. Interrupt him if you can and fight fast. Spread far for the energy blast, rebuff, interrupt where you can, fight fast. Superstition: never read an ogham stone aloud in the Cursed Forest, even a waymarker. Nicknames: 'the cutter', 'stone-eyes'. Superstition: do not look into his eyes; scholars who did say they could read for a week afterwards in a script nobody else could see. It faded, mostly.

loremasterTopic.text: A cutter of ogham who read a court stone he should not have. Every stroke he cuts in the air is a word of power.

bookPage: From Derbáil of Ardee's list: grandmother said the courts set up stones in their wood and cut their bargains on them in ogham, so that neither side could forget. An ogham-cutter went in to read them, a great scholar, and read the last one, the bargain that broke. He came out with strange eyes. Orey, the old people said; I do not know what it means and neither did grandmother. He cuts words in the air now, and they burn. Never read an ogham stone aloud in that forest, she said. Not even a waymarker. Especially not a waymarker.
